können, erkundigen Sie sich, bitte, bie der Stewardess.
Si vous ne comprenez pas cette brochure veuillez vous
informer auprès de l'hôtesse.
In the event of ditching (on water)
If such a landing is necessary you will receive prior warning. Keep calm and obey
instructions. Adjust seats to full upright position. Remove sharp objects, spectacles,
dentures and high-heeled shoes. Loosen collar and necktie. Keep all other clothing
on. Put on life-jacket. DO NOT INFLATE INSIDE AIRCRAFT.
FASTEN SEAT BELT AROUND HIPS. Remain seated. When instructed to brace
take up the following position:
Place feet apart on floor, fold arms on knees and lean forward. Remain in this position
until further instructions are given by the crew. All exits are clearly marked. The crew
will open exits, launch and inflate liferafts. A calm, purposeful approach will do much
to avert panic when leaving the aircraft.
All persons boarding the Liferafts, should sit on the high side, backs against the
tubes, feet towards the centre and hold on to the lifeline which encircles the raft.
A crew member is assigned to each raft. The rafts are equipped to keep you com-
fortable until help arrives. Each raft has a radio and distress signals.
Your hostess will demonstrate this life vest procedure.
